articles.title: How The Diplomat Season 4 Faked Windsor Castle, a Warship, and a G7 Summit
articles.summary: The series "The Diplomat" is recognized for its compelling portrayal of politics, largely attributed to Curt Beech's artistic direction. The show features wonderfully competent and dapper main characters, whose sophisticated appeal is significantly enhanced by the meticulously designed spaces and places they inhabit. This focus on aesthetic presentation makes the depiction of diplomatic life visually engaging and appealing.

articles.title: The Yankees are getting bashed for what they do wrong. Prospect J.T. Etheridge is an example of what they do right
articles.summary: The New York Yankees faced criticism after being swept by the Rays this offseason. Despite significant fan discontent, the team's leadership has opted to retain both manager Aaron Boone and General Manager Brian Cashman. This decision signals the organization's commitment to its current leadership despite calls for strategic changes following recent performance.

articles.title: Novaya Gazeta’s Journalism Will Live On
articles.summary: Novaya Gazeta, Russia's leading independent newspaper, has served as a crucial chronicler of the nation's reality for over three decades. Its extensive reporting has covered significant periods, including the promise of democracy and economic upheavals, offering an independent perspective on Russia's societal and political landscape. This long-standing presence underscores its vital role in documenting the country's complex history.

articles.title: No U-Turn: Paul Says Ropeway Will Fly From Riat Laban, Come What May
articles.summary: Shillong's newly inducted Tourism Minister, Paul Lyngdoh, announced on Thursday that the government is proceeding with the much-anticipated ropeway project. Confirming the project is "on" and the government is "not backing down," this marks a significant commitment to enhancing tourism infrastructure in Shillong. It is one of Minister Lyngdoh's first major announcements since rejoining the Cabinet, highlighting the project's priority for the state.

articles.title: India in final-stage talks to expand BrahMos missile sale to Philippines, sources say
articles.summary: India is in advanced talks with the Philippines to expand its sale of supersonic cruise missiles. This follows initial deliveries, highlighting New Delhi's growing role as a defence exporter and strengthening strategic partnerships in the Indo-Pacific region. The deal underscores India's capabilities in advanced weaponry and commitment to regional security, crucial for strategic balance.

articles.title: Capilla set for France debut as Galthie names team to face Fiji
articles.summary: Uncapped loose forward Esteban Capilla is set to make his debut for France, featuring off the bench in coach Fabien Galthie's 23-man squad for Saturday's Nations Championship fixture. This significant call-up provides Capilla an opportunity to represent his nation on the international rugby stage for the first time, marking a key milestone in his burgeoning career.

articles.title: In the mood for marriage Review: A slice of matchmaking, family drama and Bengaluru magic; A kannada web series that captures all three central flavours perfectly
articles.summary: An article reviews the Kannada web series 'In the mood for marriage,' highlighting its portrayal of matchmaking, family drama, and the vibrant atmosphere of Bengaluru. The series is praised for capturing these central cultural flavours, offering viewers a relatable slice of life. This review suggests the series is a significant contribution to regional digital content, focusing on contemporary social narratives within an Indian context.
